newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson sees 3.5 mln new mobile users/mth.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees 3.5 mln new mobile users/mth.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB on Tuesday said it estimated the global mobile phone market was expanding by 3.5 million new users a month.
A summary of reports from 127 countries shows there were 126 million mobile phone subscribers at the end of the third quarter this year, Ericsson said in a statement.
During the July-September period, about 16 million new subscribers were added, the company said.
Of these, about 60 percent, or 10.2 million people, were connected to digital systems.
Ericsson said with this growth rate, the total number of mobile phone subscribers worldwide will amount to more than 140 million at the end of the year.
During the first half of the year, mobile phone subscribers rose by 21.8 million to 109 million, corresponding to an annual growth rate of 56 percent.

Calculated on the number of subscribers served, Ericsson is the world's largest supplier of mobile networks with a 39.2 percent market share, followed by Lucent of the U.S. with 14.9 percent, Ericsson said.
Analog systems are still larger within mobile telephony with 77 million users, while digital systems have 32.7 million, Ericsson said.
